verdict.rationale: Productboard offers webhooks to receive real-time notifications on events (productboard-docs-5) and an API to act on data, which together could be composed into rule-like automation, but there is no first-party evidence of a native 'if this event then trigger this action' rules engine or automation builder inside the product itself. This requires external glue code via API/webhooks rather than a built-in automated rule definition UI or engine. missing for 10: a documented native automation/rules engine, trigger-action UI, evidence of conditional logic execution, and independent confirmation of end-to-end automation working without custom integration work.
